files.content:
1: package llmverify
2: import chisel3._
3: import chisel3.util._
4: import chiselFv._
5: 
6: class cubeAbs extends Module with Formal {
7:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
8:     val dir = Input(UInt(3.W))  // unused
9:     val start = Input(UInt(5.W))
10:     val pos = Output(UInt(5.W))
11:   })
12:   
13:   // Register for position (also output)
14:   val posReg = RegInit(0.U(5.W))
15:   
16:   // Register array for visited (27 bits)
17:   val visited = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(27)(false.B)))
18:   
19:   // Wire for next and dest
20:   val next = Wire(UInt(5.W))
21:   val dest = Wire(UInt(5.W))
22:   
23:   // Combinational logic
24:   next := Cat(io.start(4, 1), ~posReg(0))
25:   dest := Mux(next < 27.U, next, posReg)
26:   
27:   // Handle initialization - use reset to simulate initial block
28:   // When reset is asserted, initialize position and visited array
29:   val initDone = RegInit(false.B)
30:   
31:   when (!initDone) {
32:     // Initialize position with bounds checking
33:     posReg := Mux((io.start > 26.U) || (io.start === 13.U), 0.U, io.start)
34:     // Initialize visited array to all 0
35:     for (i <- 0 until 27) {
36:       visited(i) := false.B
37:     }
38:     // Mark initial position as visited
39:     visited(posReg) := true.B
40:     initDone := true.B
41:   }.otherwise {
42:     // Normal operation
43:     when (!visited(dest)) {
44:       posReg := dest
45:       visited(dest) := true.B
46:     }
47:   }
48:   
49:   // Connect output
50:   io.pos := posReg
51: 
52:   // ===== Formal Verification Assertions =====
53: 
54:   // Safety: position register is always in valid range [0, 26]
55:   fvAssert(posReg < 27.U, "pos_in_range")
56: 
57:   // Safety: destination is either in valid range [0, 26] or we stay at current position
58:   fvAssert(dest < 27.U || dest === posReg, "dest_valid")
59: 
60:   // Safety: output always matches internal position register
61:   fvAssert(io.pos === posReg, "output_consistent")
62: 
63:   // Safety: visited bits are monotonic (once set, never cleared) after initialization
64:   // A bit that was 1 in the previous cycle must still be 1 in the current cycle
65:   val visitedPrev = RegNext(visited.asUInt)
66:   fvAssert(!initDone || (visitedPrev & ~visited.asUInt) === 0.U, "visited_monotonic")
67: 
68:   // Liveness/Progress: when we are in normal operation and there is an unvisited
69:   // destination different from current position, we move to it in the next cycle
70:   assertNextStepWhen(
71:     initDone && !visited(dest) && dest =/= posReg,
72:     posReg === dest,
73:     "position_updates"
74:   )
75: }
76: 
77: object VerilogGenerator extends App {
78:   emitVerilog(new cubeAbs(), args)
79: }
